# Historical compatibility fixtures

`v0.5.1-format-v1.db` and its WAL were generated by the published `v0.5.1`
source, not by the current checkout. The compressed bytes are Base64 encoded so
the repository can review and transport them as text. The migration test checks
their uncompressed SHA-256 digests before use:

- primary: `a8fe280cfaca1029fa0b2f2f7ad72d6b7d4fb986d7c3cce38d980f4e419c8c4c`
- WAL: `bbd197887ac58138eaf970c48a8cef4cecd65d88a4a6d5af0c5b6802888d1be0`

The fixture contains two cells plus source, tag, validity, facet, edge, and raw
application records. Its primary header declares engine format v1. Keep these
bytes immutable; add a separately named fixture when another published release
needs compatibility coverage.
